summary: Bind push capability to the pairing issuer and bound complete phone registration writes

replay.detail: No additional claim or projection replay.

rules.detail: No checkpoint rule, retention or digest change.

compatibility.detail: The optional push-registration capability is granted only on the member that issued the current pairing. Other paired members advertise it unavailable instead of accepting a phone token they cannot store.

manual.detail: No manual upgrade step. Phone opt-out and forget use a bounded complete write, including response decoding. Local database backups contain registration secrets and must remain private.

recovery.detail: Failed phone writes reconcile on the next connection; registrations remain local and disposable.
